A tiny experiment: the Game of Life

A grid, three simple rules, and patterns that move, repeat, and sometimes surprise you. Try a glider, a pulsar, or a random seed. Change a few cells and watch the world unfold.

Conway's Game of Life
gen 00 alive
Your browser needs canvas support to display the Game of Life.
a few simple rules. a little room for surprise.

Three neighbors bring a cell to life. Two or three keep it alive. Otherwise it disappears. The edges wrap around.
Click or drag to draw. Keyboard: Space to pause, arrow keys to move, Enter to toggle a cell.
